label: mcl_core_bone_block_top
reference_prompt: Create a close visual reference for the end face of a dense bone block in a grounded dark-fantasy world. Unlike the longitudinal side, this face reveals compact cross-sectional bone structure: fine concentric or clustered osteon-like mineral organization, tiny restrained pores, dense ivory tissue and subtle age-darkened channels. Keep it dry, ancient and non-gory, with muted bone-white, cream and gray-yellow variation. Avoid marrow cavities, sliced meat, skull motifs, perfect decorative circles or polished ivory. The material should reveal that the same fibrous bone has been viewed across its structural direction.
